stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO enters third and final bidding day with ~22% grey‑market premium
stories.summary: Jio Platforms' IPO entered its third and final bidding day on 23 October 2026. In the grey market the issue traded at an approximate 22 % premium, reflecting strong investor demand. Brokerage analysts noted Jio’s dominant telecom position, improving profitability and growth prospects in broadband and artificial‑intelligence services.
stories.why: The premium and broker optimism indicate how the market may price India’s largest‑ever public offering.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: Ohio Democratic candidate Amy Acton calls opponent’s ad featuring estranged mother despicable
stories.summary: Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton said a television advertisement released by Republican challenger Vivek Ramaswamy was “despicable.” The ad features Acton’s estranged mother, Donna Arthur, who accuses Acton of lying her whole life. The spot does not mention that Arthur’s husband had been charged with raping Acton as a child and that Acton and her brother were subsequently removed from her custody.
stories.why: The controversy may affect voter perceptions in a tightly contested Ohio governor’s race.

stories.title: France extends curfew in Paris and bans protests in Marseille and Lyon amid weekend riots
stories.summary: Paris is extending a partial curfew limiting movement in parts of the city until Monday, while Marseille and Lyon ban all protests this weekend. The Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums in Paris will also close on Saturday as more demonstrations are expected. France is still dealing with weekend disorder when protests over the cost of living and school conditions were overshadowed by riots and looting that damaged businesses and historic buildings. Only authorised union demonstrations are allowed elsewhere, President Macron said.
stories.why: The measures restrict citizens' freedom of assembly and key cultural venues during an ongoing period of civil unrest.
stories.previousTitle: France extends curfew in Paris and bans protests in Marseille and Lyon after weekend riots
stories.previousSummary: Paris is extending a partial curfew that restricts movement in parts of the city until Monday, while Marseille and Lyon have imposed a total ban on protests for the weekend. The Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums in Paris will be closed on Saturday. The measures follow large protests over the cost of living and school conditions that escalated into riots and looting, damaging businesses and historic buildings.

stories.title: RBI watches widening interest‑rate gap with G7 amid inflation concerns
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India said the widening interest‑rate gap with G7 economies is a key factor as it evaluates rising inflation and input‑cost pressures. Recent data show Indian GDP growth staying resilient, supported by strong private consumption and exports. YES Bank projects that the RBI could implement a cumulative 50‑basis‑point rate increase.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.previousSummary: The Reserve Bank of India is monitoring the interest‑rate gap with major G7 economies while assessing rising inflation and input‑cost pressures. Recent GDP data show resilience, supported by strong private consumption and exports. YES Bank forecasts a cumulative RBI policy‑rate increase of 50 basis points.

stories.title: RBI directs banks, payment firms to clear tech environments after data breach
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued a directive requiring banks and payment service providers to carry out forensic clearance of their technology environments whenever a data breach is reported, to identify and remediate compromised systems and protect customer data. The order is part of the regulator’s effort to reinforce cybersecurity across the financial sector.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.
stories.previousTitle: RBI asks banks, payment firms to forensically clear tech environments in case of a data breach
stories.previousSummary: The RBI has asked financial entities to remove management and administrative interfaces from public internet access, enforce multi-factor authentication for administrative access, and restrict access to cloud and backend systems on a least-privilege basis. The RBI issued the advisory on October 19, shortly after CERT-In warned about the growing use of artificial intelligence agents to carry out cyberattacks.

stories.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
stories.summary: When the Houthis reached their village in the Kahboub mountains in south-west Yemen, their family of seven was forced to flee amid bombs, missiles, and drone attacks – the twins protected only by blankets. Image caption, The twins' family walked for three days before being given a lift to Aden

stories.previousTitle: Premature twins struggle to survive after fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen’s Kahboub mountains
stories.previousSummary: Seven‑week‑old twins Raghad Hassan and Raad, born prematurely, have been fighting for survival as fighting intensified in Yemen’s civil war. When Houthi forces reached their village in the Kahboub mountains, their family of seven fled on foot with only blankets. During the walk the twins grew weaker, with worsening vomiting and diarrhoea, their mother Lina said.

stories.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
stories.summary: OpenAI made its Decisions API model widely available to users for the first time, entering the market for fast, cheap intelligence that recently made TypeSafe, a startup founded by a former researcher at the frontier lab, a $7.6 billion company . TypeSafe’s Jev model created a category for deep learning models that act as super classifiers: Given a set of options, they can quickly make choices and offer a confidence rating in their decision.
